    b = board.copy()
    # Play first move
    play_move(b, first_move[0], first_move[1], ME)
    
    # Setup tracking
    empty_set = set((r,c) for r in range(SIZE) for c in range(SIZE) if b[r,c]==EMPTY)
    # Frontier: empty points adjacent to stones

    for r,c in [(first_move[0], first_move[1])]:

            if b[nr, nc] == EMPTY:
                frontier.add((nr, nc))
    
    cur = OPP
    passes = 0
    max_moves = 60 # limit game length for speed
    
    for _ in range(max_moves):
        if passes >= 2:
            break
        # Generate move
        # Try frontier first (more realistic)
        legal_moves = []
        # Shuffle frontier
        front_list = list(frontier)
        random.shuffle(front_list)
        for pos in front_list:
            if pos in empty_set and is_legal_move(b, pos[0], pos[1], cur):
                legal_moves.append(pos)
                if len(legal_moves) >= 5: # enough to choose
                    break
        
        if not legal_moves:
            # Try all empty (unlikely)
            all_empty = list(empty_set)
            random.shuffle(all_empty)
            for pos in all_empty[:50]: # limit check
                if is_legal_move(b, pos[0], pos[1], cur):
                    legal_moves.append(pos)
                    break
        
        if not legal_moves:
            passes += 1
            cur = ME if cur == OPP else OPP
            continue
        
        move = legal_moves[0]
        # Update board
        captured = play_move(b, move[0], move[1], cur)
        empty_set.discard(move)
        # Add new frontier

        # Remove captured from frontier/add to empty

                if b[nr, nc] == EMPTY:
                    frontier.add((nr, nc))
        
        passes = 0
        cur = ME if cur == OPP else OPP
    
    return evaluate_board(b)

from collections import deque

SIZE = 19
EMPTY = 0
ME = 1
OPP = 2

        if r < SIZE-1: n.append((r+1, c))
        if c > 0: n.append((r, c-1))
        if c < SIZE-1: n.append((r, c+1))
        NEIGHBORS.append(n)

def idx(r, c):

def get_neighbors(r, c):

def get_group_and_liberties(board, r, c):

    group = set()
    liberties = set()
    dq = deque([(r, c)])
    group.add((r, c))
    while dq:

        for nr, nc in get_neighbors(cr, cc):
            if board[nr][nc] == EMPTY:
                liberties.add((nr, nc))
            elif board[nr][nc] == color and (nr, nc) not in group:
                group.add((nr, nc))
                dq.append((nr, nc))
    return group, liberties

def has_liberty_other_than(board, r, c, br, bc):

    color = board[r][c]
    # Optimization: check direct neighbors first
    for nr, nc in get_neighbors(r, c):
        if board[nr][nc] == EMPTY and (nr != br or nc != bc):

    # If not found in immediate neighbors, do full BFS (rare for capture check)
    visited = set([(r, c)])

    while dq:
